t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Learn which gnomes on average give you the best return. Use the 5x multiplyer for safe bets and the 1x to learn which gnomes give you the best result. Be consistent on average.

vb_textbox.text: Try to figure out which gnomes have any value. I don't think there is a pattern. So try to only use the 5x for the gnomes you are certain give you the bigger result. Use the 1x to work out which gnomes.
